text:
elaine_sales: Hey team, NovaLedger wants to run a POC to replace FastPrompt's inference for their doc-summarize flow. They're worried about output parity, token billing differences, and a security questionnaire from their procurement. Can we get a short checklist (POC success criteria, pricing estimate, security caveats) and confirm whether we can match the FastPrompt request/response shape?

mike_solution_eng: ok noted. quick Qs — do they use streaming partials for user-visible UI, or just a sync call? also can you paste a sample FastPrompt request/response?

elaine_sales: they use streaming in the UI (partial paragraphs). sample request from them: ```POST https://api.fastprompt.io/v1/summarize 
Content-Type: application/json
{ "document": "<long text>", "mode": "concise", "stream": true }```
and sample response chunks look like: ```{ "event":"chunk","payload":{"text":"The report shows ..."}}```

sophia_se: security flags: SOC2 attestation yes/no, data residency (they want EU-only for some clients), KMS/HSM for keys, and an IP allowlist for our callback endpoints. We'll need to run their standard security questionnaire — I can fill it but need DPIA and retention policy details from legal.

tom_infra: for private connectivity we can offer a VPC peering option + static egress IPs. cert rotation + short-lived creds are supported. if they insist on on-prem, that's a separate Private deployment quote.

mike_solution_eng: technical parity notes: Redwood's streaming uses chunked JSON messages with fields {"part":"text","delta":"...","done":false}. FastPrompt's events are different but mappable — we should provide a lightweight translation shim in the SDK to convert events -> our UI shape. watch out: FastPrompt includes incremental metadata tokens-per-chunk which they bill differently. Expect token accounting delta ~1.15-1.4x depending on tokenizer & prompt wrapping.

elaine_sales: pricing concern — they currently pay $0.0009/token with FastPrompt at their scale (~200M tokens/month). If token delta is +20% on average, can we propose a blended intro rate and a committed capacity option?

mike_solution_eng: yes — recommend a 3-month POC flat rate + optional reserved capacity if they commit to a 6-12 month term. Example: POC tier = $6k flat for up to 10M tokens (trial), then dedicated reserved pool starting at $0.0006/token with volume tiers. We'll get finance to produce exact numbers. Also: enabling batching + prefix KV cache can reduce effective tokens by ~10-30% for repeated prompts.

legal_aaron: we can sign an EU DPA and standard DPAs. For retention: default 30 days logs + option to extend for auditing, data export on termination — that's standard. Need to confirm they require non-disclosure of model artifacts.

sophia_se: next steps for the security questionnaire: 1) I will fill the vendor form (takes ~48h) 2) provide SOC2 cert + penetration test report 3) confirm KMS/SAML/SAML2 SSO options 4) provide audit-log sample schema. I'll ping when questionnaire draft is ready.

deploy-bot: deploy prod/redwood-runtime v4.12.1 to fleet-us-east-1 succeeded — no infra impact expected for POC. :white_check_mark:

mike_solution_eng: small implementation checklist for the eng LOE: 
- quick translation shim in their frontend (map FastPrompt events -> our stream schema)
- opt-in mode for "compat-stream" (no model change)
- smoke tests: sample payload (use this): ```curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -d '{"input":"<doc text>","options":{"stream":true}}'```
- compare first 5 user-visible chunks between FastPrompt and Redwood for 100 sample docs (automated diff)

elaine_sales: perfect. Can you prepare a short one-pager for the customer: POC scope, acceptance criteria, estimated pricing delta, and security attachments? I can then sync with Procurement this Friday at 10am PST.

mike_solution_eng: yes — I'll draft the one-pager + minimal shim reference by EOD tomorrow. meeting Friday 10am PST works. :thumbsup:

sophia_se: I'll attach the filled security questionnaire and SOC2 link to the one-pager when ready.

elaine_sales: thanks everyone — main blockers to call out for procurement: tokenization billing delta, EU-only tenancy need, and any contractual retention exceptions. If we can get those answered this week, we'll be green to start the POC next week.

mike_solution_eng: TL;DR action items: eli (sales) collect FastPrompt sample logs + target SLA; sophia fill sec questionnaire; tom confirm VPC peering IPs and time to provision; legal prep DPA. I'll assemble shim PR post-approval.

elaine_sales: noted. tagging @mike_solution_eng @sophia_se @tom_infra @legal_aaron. cheers.
